description: Hotkeys the player uses. One row per key; each generates a constant and a dispatch entry (gta: gta/src/gen/keys.hpp, beamng: input action JSON + gen/keys.lua).

columns.side: gta (read by BeamLS.asi) or beamng (a BeamNG input action the mod adds)
columns.input: gta: vk:<hex Windows virtual key> or control:<GTA control index>; beamng: the BeamNG binding name
columns.label: Text shown to the player (English; GTA help text)

rows.action: Pause the car, bring BeamNG to the front with its vehicle selector open
rows.context: on foot or driving, BeamNG connected, not paused
rows.label: F6: choose a BeamNG car

rows.action: Pause the car, bring BeamNG to the front with its tuning menu open
rows.context: a BeamNG car exists, BeamNG connected
rows.label: F7: tune your BeamNG car

rows.action: Park and hide the BeamNG car and stop the mashup, or bring it back
rows.label: F8: BeamNG on/off

rows.action: Repair the BeamNG car at Los Santos Customs
rows.context: car stopped inside a garage zone (sheet garages)
rows.label: E: repair at Los Santos Customs

rows.action: Close BeamNG's menu and return to GTA
rows.context: BeamNG menu opened by the mashup
rows.label: F6: back to Los Santos
rows.notes: Added as BeamNG input action beamls_back with default bindings F6 and F7 (lua/ge/extensions/core/input/actions/beamls.json).
